releasenotes: "Send post" no longer waits for Elasticsearch. A new post, an edit, hiding or deleting content sent the search engine up to six requests (fifteen for a post through the REST API) while the member waited: 123 ms per reply on average on a forum, seconds at the worst moments, 1.3 s per post from the mobile app. Under PHP-FPM the same changes are now made by IPS's own code, in the same order, right after the page has been sent; the post is loaded from the database again then, so a post deleted or hidden in the meantime is indexed as it is. On Elasticsearch 7.17 in a test: a reply 41-50 ms -> 4-5 ms. Also fixed: emails of tasks IPS runs while ending a request were never sent. Separate switch; needs Elasticsearch and PHP-FPM.
